Class MarketController

java.lang.Object
app.market.MarketController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/market") public class MarketController extends Object
Public, read-only endpoints for simulated stock snapshots, charts, and live ticks.

      @GetMapping(value="/stream", produces="text/event-stream") public org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation.SseEmitter stream(@RequestParam(required=false) Long sessionId, @RequestHeader(value="Last-Event-ID",required=false) Long lastEventId, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request)
